description:
Behind every expensive product, food, and high-cost job, there's a fascinating story. 

Lapis lazuli is the most expensive pigment in the world, but the Afghan mines used to make it the traditional way have recently closed. The curling stones used in the Winter Olympics may not look special until you realize they come from only one remote island. And Canada Goose jackets weren't always considered a luxury good. 

We uncover the stories behind 14 of the world's most expensive things.
